levels.chua_dat: Below the program's academic standard (Hold a Bachelor's Degree in Business Administration, Commerce, Economics, Supply Chain or related fields. GPA of 3.0/4.0 or equivalent (preferred) Are fresh graduates or have up to 1 year of working experience.) or the CV does not clearly state GPA/major.
levels.dat: Hold a Bachelor's Degree in Business Administration, Commerce, Economics, Supply Chain or related fields. GPA of 3.0/4.0 or equivalent (preferred) Are fresh graduates or have up to 1 year of working experience.
levels.noi_bat: GPA ~8.5/10 (3.5/4.0) or above, scholarship or top departmental ranking; major closely matches the applied track, or holds a double degree/supplementary professional certificate.

levels.chua_dat: CV shows no evidence of English proficiency (certificate, English-medium program, English-speaking work environment). Program standard: Have good English communication skills (equivalent to TOEIC 650+, IELTS 6.0+, or similar).
levels.dat: Have good English communication skills (equivalent to TOEIC 650+, IELTS 6.0+, or similar).
levels.noi_bat: IELTS 7.0+/TOEIC 900+ or has studied/worked entirely in English; confident presenting, debating cases, and interviewing on a panel in English.

levels.chua_dat: No leadership role shown: only a club member, or the CV shows no meaningful extracurricular activity.
levels.dat: Demonstrate leadership potential through academic, extracurricular, or professional experiences.
levels.noi_bat: Club president / lead organizer of a large-scale event / project founder — with measurable results (team size led, budget scale, growth achieved).

levels.chua_dat: No internship/work experience relevant to: Have a strong interest in retail, customer experience, and people management.
levels.dat: Have a strong interest in retail, customer experience, and people management.
levels.noi_bat: Two or more relevant internships, or one internship with a measurable achievement (KPI hit, project actually shipped) at a company in the same industry as MUJI.

levels.chua_dat: No evidence of analytical thinking: no quantitative coursework, data project, or case-practice experience.
levels.dat: Has an analytical foundation (quantitative coursework, strong Excel, prior case practice) — enough to pass the program's assessment/aptitude test.
levels.noi_bat: Case competition achievements or a real analytical project + solid tools (advanced Excel, SQL/Python if the track needs it) — ready for both aptitude tests and assessment centres.

levels.chua_dat: CV does not mention any award, scholarship, or competition.
levels.dat: Has taken part in an academic/case competition or won a school-level scholarship/award.
levels.noi_bat: Reached the final rounds or won a major competition (case competitions in the relevant industry, national hackathon/datathon) or a national-level scholarship/award.

levels.chua_dat: CV shows no genuine interest signal or motivation tied to MUJI or its industry; generic application reasons only.
levels.dat: Have a strong interest in retail, customer experience, and people management. Possess strong communication and interpersonal skills. Are willing to work flexible shifts, including weekends and public holidays. Are eager to learn, adaptable, and ready to take on challenges.
levels.noi_bat: A clear, specific story connecting personal motivation, prior projects, and understanding of MUJI's business/brand/values in Vietnam.

ideal_profile_text:
Hold a Bachelor's Degree in Business Administration, Commerce, Economics, Supply Chain or related fields.
GPA of 3.0/4.0 or equivalent (preferred)
Are fresh graduates or have up to 1 year of working experience.
Have a strong interest in retail, customer experience, and people management.
Demonstrate leadership potential through academic, extracurricular, or professional experiences.
Possess strong communication and interpersonal skills.
Are willing to work flexible shifts, including weekends and public holidays.
Have good English communication skills (equivalent to TOEIC 650+, IELTS 6.0+, or similar).
Are eager to learn, adaptable, and ready to take on challenges.
